What was your favorite board game when you were younger and how have your game tastes changed now?

Man I love board games but unfortunately haven't played any in a while. My friends typically aren't too into them. Risk was always a personal favorite. I also enjoyed Life and Monopoly. Now I'm a big fan of Cataan and I really want to give Diplomacy a try.

I adored playing Chess and Scrabble with my dad, mostly Checkers and Chinese Checkers with my one grandma, and I played Bridge, Rook, Poker, Rummy and other card games with my other grandma and her sisters every week growing up.

The biggest difference now is that I don't really have people to play with. My partner isn't into board gaming. So I stick to solitaire-based games and those with solitaire variants--Onirim, Urbion, Tokaido, Fantastiqa , Morels, Galaxy Trucker. I own a lot of two-player ones in hopes of eventually bribing my second player into playing.

I still love two-player abstracts, and mainly play those online at BoardSpace, or Chess and Go websites.

A lot of this really comes down to your personal play style. As long as it works for you then it doesn't matter.

I play a warrior, but my setup is generally the same no matter what I play. Bar 1 is what I use most. If I'm healing, bar 1 is all healing spells. Bar 2 is usually my instants and procs. Bar three are my cooldowns and buffs. This works for me and it's the system I've used in every MMO. I like this setup because the abilities I use most will not need a shift/alt/ctrl modifier, and situational abilities do.

Do you feel uncomfortable with your current setup? That's really the biggest thing. As long as you're comfortable then it really doesn't matter. Everyone will have a different opinion!
